0022600229.text: Dallas (7-4, on a three-game win streak and 7-3 over its last ten) visits Minnesota (8-3, on a four-game win streak) for the Mavericks' 12th game of the season. Dallas is 9th in the West and 4th in the Southwest, 2 games back, while Minnesota is 2nd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back, and 4th in the West. Dereck Lively II (out, foot surgery), Sergio de Larrea (out, knee strain), Tarik Biberovic (out, heel inflammation) and Morez Johnson Jr. (day-to-day, leg, game-time decision) are unavailable for Dallas, while Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery) are out for Minnesota, and the teams have not met yet this season after Dallas lost all four games to Minnesota in 2025-26, most recently 124-94 in Dallas on March 30.
